For a small startup, these are three practical Noida options currently offering furnished/private-office formats:

Option	Indicative cost	What differentiates it
Nukleus Coworking & Managed Offices	Quote-based	Managed-office focus; good if you want a more conventional dedicated office rather than just coworking. Sector 142.
Workspaces by Innova	Quote-based	Sector 63 location and 24×7 access; potentially practical for a cost-conscious early-stage team.
WeWork Galaxy Business Park	₹14,000/desk/month	Fully furnished private offices, meeting rooms, Wi-Fi, support and coffee included. Sector 62. 
WeWork India
+1

My shortlist logic: For a 4–8 person startup, compare total monthly rent + GST + deposit + meeting-room credits + electricity/maintenance + lock-in rather than headline seat price. WeWork has the clearest published pricing; Awfis also offers plug-and-play 2–9-person cabins, with monthly-to-yearly terms.

For a two-floor Pune home, I’d shortlist these:

Model	Approx. price	Key features	Availability
TP-Link Deco X20 (2-pack)	₹11,399	Wi-Fi 6, AX1800, 150+ devices, Ethernet backhaul	Good; Flipkart/Moglix
TP-Link Deco X50 (3-pack)	~₹20,500	Wi-Fi 6, AX3000, stronger capacity, ideal for larger homes	Available via online sellers
Tenda Nova MW6 (3-pack)	₹13,000–16,000	AC1200, 3 nodes, simple whole-home coverage	Available; Flipkart/retailers

Flipkart
+2
TP-Link

My pick: Deco X20 for best value. For a larger/longer two-floor house, choose X50 3-pack. MW6 is the budget option but uses older Wi-Fi 5.

For Pune, check delivery to your exact pincode before ordering.
